# cortexcloud_container_registry (Data Source)

Provides details about a third-party container registry connector (CWP Registry Onboarding).

`password` and `auth_token` are never returned by the API and are always empty in this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cortexcloud_container_registry" "example" {
  id = "conn-1234567890"
}

output "container_registry_name" {
  value = data.cortexcloud_container_registry.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The connector ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `allow_static_ips` (Boolean) Whether static IP addresses are allowed.
- `asset_scope_filters` (Attributes) Filters that scope which registry assets are scanned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asset_scope_filters))
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Never returned by the API.
- `broker_id` (String) The broker ID used for BROKER scanning.
- `broker_type` (String) The Broker VM type used for BROKER scanning.
- `ca_certificate` (String) The CA certificate used to authenticate the registry.
- `cloud_provider` (String) The Cortex cloud provider used for CLOUD scanning.
- `docker_hub` (Attributes) Docker Hub-specific options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker_hub))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is enabled.
- `filter_type` (String) Whether asset_scope_filters include or exclude assets.
- `gitlab` (Attributes) GitLab-specific options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gitlab))
- `initial_scan_configuration` (Attributes) Which images were scanned when the connector was onboarded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_scan_configuration))
- `insecure_pull` (Boolean) Whether insecure image pulls are allowed.
- `ip_identifier` (String) The identifier associated with the static IP address.
- `name` (String) The name of the registry connector.
- `openshift` (Attributes) OpenShift-specific options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--openshift))
- `outpost_id` (String) The outpost ID used for OUTPOST scanning.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Never returned by the API.
- `region` (String) The region used for scanning.
- `registry_type` (String) Whether the registry is cloud hosted or self hosted.
- `repository` (String) The repository used for image discovery.
- `scanning_mode` (String) Where scanning runs.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant ID the connector belongs to.
- `url` (String) The URL of the registry.
- `username` (String) The username for registry authentication.
- `vendor` (String) The registry vendor.
